title: Full body blast w/ landmine and cardio
author: Brian M.
desc: This 16-week program is built to get you stronger, leaner, and more athletic. Week 1 hits the classics with barbells and dumbbells, while Week 2 switches it up with landmine training for fresh angles and explosive power. Every workout blends strength, conditioning, and core work so you’re not just lifting — you’re building real performance. Stick to the plan, push yourself each week, and watch your strength and conditioning take off.
